profile.Name: Blue Cleaver Boss
profile.Backstory: He leads the Blue Cleavers from the Blue Cleaver Hideout in the Swamp. Discontented Shek recruits have hardened his gang, which fights in a frenzy with cleaver-like weapons and is at war with the Swamp Ninjas, the Red Sabres, and the Green Katanas.
profile.SpeechQuirks: No speech of his own is recorded.
